mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 3.5% over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.5% over the prior 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing slowdown regime (INDPRO < 100) indicates reduced industrial output, lowering corporate profit margins and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential mortgage credit (RSAFS) above $700 billion indicates strong housing market demand, boosting construction and consumer spending, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS exceeds $700 billion, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained CPI inflation rate above 3.5% over the prior 3 months signals monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates labor market stress, reducing household income and consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.0% over the prior 3 months signals monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
